template_usage: Exactly one packet per change cluster. Replace every null with a concrete value; keep the fixed false flags false. Validate with the frozen validator before sending. The validator is authoritative: if a filled packet is rejected, fix the packet, never the validator.
escrow_statement: The adjudication target (REUSE/REOPEN/CANNOT_CHECK) is escrowed gold. ORION never authors, infers, or commits targets or strata. Completed packets are held outside ORION until candidate and baseline predictions are durably frozen; only then are they released to the allocator as the gold side of the evaluation.
adjudication_must_precede: curator_receipt.adjudication_started_before_prediction_reveal must be true and honest: stratum and target adjudication starts before any ORION-side candidate or baseline prediction exists.

field_guidance.cluster_id: Stable identifier for the change cluster this packet adjudicates, unique across all packets in the batch (e.g. a3-cluster-<workflow_id>).
field_guidance.source.workflow_id: WorkflowHub workflow id that is a member of the frozen 128-family successor frame.
field_guidance.source.version_before: Integer before-state version id; must exactly match the durable source receipt for this workflow.
field_guidance.source.version_after: Integer after-state version id; must exactly match the durable source receipt for this workflow.
field_guidance.source.license_before: Before-state licence string; must exactly match the durable source receipt.
field_guidance.source.license_after: After-state licence string; must exactly match the durable source receipt.
field_guidance.source.before_normalized_sha256: Before-state normalized RO-Crate content manifest SHA-256; must exactly match the durable source receipt.
field_guidance.source.after_normalized_sha256: After-state normalized RO-Crate content manifest SHA-256; must exactly match the durable source receipt and differ from before_normalized_sha256.
field_guidance.lineage.source_family_id: Identifier of the source family the cluster belongs to (e.g. workflowhub:<workflow_id>).
field_guidance.lineage.normalized_organization_lineage: The normalized organization lineage string for this family as used in allocation; one lineage per cluster across the whole pool.
field_guidance.lineage.artifact_lineage_id: Identifier of the artifact lineage (derived-from chain) this cluster's change belongs to.
field_guidance.candidate_visible_packet_sha256: SHA-256 (hex, 64 lowercase) over the frozen candidate-visible packet bytes (the normalized member manifests actually shown to the candidate policy) - binds the packet to the exact substrate the candidate will see.
field_guidance.adjudication.stratum: Exactly one of: representation_schema, responsibility_output_contract, objective_acceptance_criterion, evidence_dependency.
field_guidance.adjudication.target: Exactly one of: REUSE, REOPEN, CANNOT_CHECK (three-valued gold; escrowed, never committed inside ORION).
field_guidance.adjudication.rationale: Non-empty human-readable justification for the stratum and target, citing the before/after change.
field_guidance.adjudication.evidence_refs: Non-empty list of non-empty references (member paths, metadata fields, or diff anchors inside the two RO-Crate versions) supporting the adjudication.
field_guidance.adjudication.disagreement_record.disagre: true if any adjudicator disagreement occurred, else false (must be an explicit boolean).
field_guidance.adjudication.disagreement_record.resolut: null (or empty) when disagreement_observed is false; a non-empty resolution statement when true.
field_guidance.adjudication.disagreement_record.notes: Always required, non-empty: how adjudication was performed, who was involved, what was checked.
field_guidance.curator_receipt.curator_id: Stable identifier of the external curator (person or role) authoring the packet.
field_guidance.curator_receipt.adjudicated_at_utc: UTC timestamp string of adjudication completion (e.g. 2026-09-10T14:03:00Z).
field_guidance.curator_receipt.receipt_sha256: SHA-256 (hex, 64 lowercase) over the canonical packet body (the curator's own receipt hash, excluding the receipt_sha256 field).
field_guidance.curator_receipt.independence_attested: Must be true: attests independence from ORION-side prediction and outcome custody.
field_guidance.curator_receipt.adjudication_started_bef: Must be true: adjudication started before any candidate or baseline prediction was revealed.
field_guidance.curator_receipt.orion_predictions_visibl: Fixed false: ORION candidate predictions were not visible during adjudication.
field_guidance.curator_receipt.baseline_predictions_vis: Fixed false: baseline predictions were not visible during adjudication.
field_guidance.curator_receipt.protected_outcomes_visib: Fixed false: protected outcomes were not visible during adjudication.
field_guidance.candidate_predictions_in_packet: Fixed false: the packet must not contain candidate predictions.
field_guidance.baseline_predictions_in_packet: Fixed false: the packet must not contain baseline predictions.
field_guidance.protected_outcomes_in_packet: Fixed false: the packet must not contain protected outcomes.

fixed_false_flags_explanation: The nine visibility/presence flags marked 'fixed false' are structural custody assertions; the frozen validator rejects any packet where they are not exactly false.
template_completeness: This template lists every field the frozen validator enforces; no additional fields are required.
